findings.evidence: `ext` on `@[ext] structure ReconstructedInvariants` (AccessMethods.lean:162) yields goals in projection form, so these `exact`s type-check only up to delta. The needed lemmas exist and are used elsewhere: `sigmaMethod_Q2` (AccessMethods.lean:277), `mixedMethod_Q2`/`mixedMethod_y` (AccessMethods.lean:285), `TrueInvariants.toReconstructedInvariants_x/_Q2` (Radiative.lean:317), `_y` (Radiative.lean:236).
findings.fix: Prefix each with the available lemma, e.g. `rw [TrueInvariants.toReconstructedInvariants_x]; exact …` at 234, `rw [sigmaMethod_Q2]; exact hQ` at 320, `rw [mixedMethod_y, TrueInvariants.toReconstructedInvariants_y]; exact hy` at 334, and at 296 finish through `trueInvariants_x/_Q2/_y` + `toReconstructedInvariants_*` instead of `rwa`.
findings.issue: Six component goals are discharged by definitional unfolding of the method/invariant wrappers rather than by the generated projection lemmas: 234-235 (`exact e.hadronicMethod_x_eq_trueInvariants_x g .finalState` / `_Q2_` need `toReconstructedInvariants.x ≡ t.x`), 296 (`rwa ... at hK` needs `(trueInvariants g l).toReconstructedInvariants ≡ ⟨(hardKinematics l).xBj g, …⟩`, i.e. delta on two defs plus structure eta), 320 and 333 (`exact hQ` needs `sigmaMethod.Q2 ≡ electronMethod.Q2`, `mixedMethod.Q2 ≡ electronMethod.Q2`), 321 and 334 (`exact hy` needs `toReconstructedInvariants.y ≡ t.y`, `mixedMethod.y ≡ hadronicMethod.y`). The file is inconsistent about this: line 236 rewrites with `TrueInvariants.toReconstructedInvariants_y` for exactly the same step.

findings.evidence: `@[simps (rhsMd := .default)] def electronMethod` (AccessMethods.lean:199) generates `electronMethod_Q2 : (electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2 = -g (k - kPrime) (k - kPrime)`, used by name at Radiative.lean:377, 428 and 537.
findings.fix: State `hQ` as `(electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2 = d.q2Electron` and open its proof with `rw [electronMethod_Q2]`, or write `· rw [electronMethod_Q2]; exact hQ`.
findings.issue: Same pattern: `hQ : -g (k - kPrime) (k - kPrime) = d.q2Electron` (line 306) is passed by `exact hQ` to the goal `(electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2 = d.q2Electron`, which holds only by unfolding `electronMethod` through `ofTransfer` to its `Q2` field, while line 311 of the same proof rewrites with `electronMethod_x` by name.

findings.evidence: Chain at Radiative.lean:498-499; `left_eq_add` (Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/MinimalAxioms.lean:58) and `add_sub_left_comm` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Eigenspace/Basic.lean:671) are upstream names; `module` is defined at Mathlib/Tactic/Module.lean:762 and `linear_combination (norm := module) h` is exercised at MathlibTest/module.lean:161.
findings.fix: Use the module automation, e.g. `constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination (norm := module) h`, and close line 506 with `module`-based normalization after `rw [photon_eq_smul_kPrime_add_photon_iff.1 hcol]`.
findings.issue: `photon_eq_smul_kPrime_add_photon_iff` is proved by a seven-step chain of upstream rewrites (`smul_add, sub_smul, one_smul, add_sub_left_comm, left_eq_add, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm`) for a goal that is plain module arithmetic; the chain both obscures why the iff holds and breaks on any rename of `left_eq_add`/`add_sub_left_comm` (`left_eq_add` is itself a recent Mathlib rename). `kPrime_eq_smul_leptonOut_of_collinear_finalState` (line 506) has the same shape.

summary: Several component goals are closed by delta-unfolding the method definitions (sigmaMethod.Q2 ≡ electronMethod.Q2, mixedMethod.y ≡ hadronicMethod.y, toReconstructedInvariants.x ≡ t.x) even though the @[simps] lemmas exist and are used on neighbouring lines, and one iff is proved by a seven-step chain of upstream rewrites. Both are one-line fixes.
